Enrich person.name: Connie Clem
Enrich person.title: Director, Payment Integrity
Enrich person.summary:
Driving payment accuracy, policy governance, and financial integrity across healthcare—seasoned Payment Integrity leader seeking to make an immediate impact in a leadership role.
Healthcare Payment Integrity leader with 10+ years of experience driving claims accuracy, medical policy, and edit governance across Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace, and Commercial lines. Known for translating complex coding and regulatory requirements into actionable edit logic that improves payment accuracy, reduces risk, and strengthens compliance.
Proven track record partnering across clinical, compliance, IT, and analytics teams to deliver data-driven solutions, optimize claims performance, and enhance operational efficiency. Experienced in leading high-performing teams, building strong vendor relations, and implementing governance frameworks that balance compliance with business needs.
Recognized SME in medical payment policy and claims editing, with both payer and provider perspective—understanding not just how claims should be billed, but how they are submitted in practice.
Following a recent organizational transformation, I am seeking my next opportunity where I can bring my hands-on analytical expertise, policy knowledge, and process improvement focus to drive meaningful payment integrity outcomes.
Enrich person.headline: Director Payment Integrity at Centene Corporation
